name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: As an EU/Schengen member, Latvia follows the standard Schengen short-stay rule: up to 90 days within any 180-day period, either visa-free (for exempt nationalities) or on a Schengen (C) visa.
No lucrative work is permitted under this status.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period

sources.title: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP) -- confirms a residence permit is required only for stays exceeding 90 days within a 6-month period, consistent with the general EU/Schengen short-stay rule
